units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:8">Kil. IX, 8</cite> (play on <he>נ̇ז̇</he> in <cite ref="U01650"><he>שעטנז</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="N00336"><he>נוּז</he></cite>) <he>נָלוֹז ומֵלִיז הוא את אביו שבשמים עליו</he> (or <he>ומַלִּיז</he>) he (who disregards the law of <cite ref="U01650"><he>שַׁעטְנֵז</he></cite>) is perverse and turns his Father in heaven against him; [Comment. ‘and turns away (estranges) his Father … on his account’].
